scope: Registered complete-source consistency; no language execution, production parser/type check, XLSX calculation or PDF visual QA.

method.source_normalization: LF, code.strip() + final LF; ordered source_files joined with one blank line
method.nonwhitespace_characters: Unicode code points with str.isspace()==False; declarations, Throws, comments and literals included
method.utf8_bytes: Complete canonical source encoded in UTF-8, including whitespace and final LF
method.styles: Both registered styles are counted independently; the legacy LMX listing is only a compatibility mirror
method.boundaries: All declared source_files, once per style; shared helpers never disappear from the measurement
method.markdown: Shown full bodies/fragments match registered sources; linked common helper bodies remain fully counted
method.csv: Dynamic ordered columns for actual per-record languages/styles; absent foreign values stay empty
method.artifacts: Only workbook ZIP integrity and PDF signatures; rendering/formula validation is separate
